summary: Murano Global Investments PLC filed a Form 6-K disclosing a delay in the early settlement of Banco Multiva's exchange offer and consent solicitation for $303M aggregate principal of 11.000% Senior Secured Notes due 2031. The exchange was to swap existing notes for Fixed Rate Senior Secured Notes due 2032. Issuer Trustee announced settlement did not occur July 28, 2026, because conditions were not satisfied or waived; the Early Settlement Date has been extended per the offering memorandum. All tenders and consents are irrevocable. The issuer will continue working with the Ad Hoc Group and advisors toward satisfaction or waiver. This is a debt-exchange delay, not a special situation.
